slides.title: About this study
items: UK adults aged 18-64 open to using a meal-kit delivery service in the next 12 months
Randomised monadic: each respondent saw one of 3 concepts (Flex n=700, Plus n=700, Simple n=700).
wt_final. Percentages are weighted; bases are unweighted.
Wald tests on Kish effective bases. Pairwise concept comparisons are Holm-adjusted within each measure. A difference is 'material' at 5 pts or more.
Food explorers is the pre-specified subgroup; interactions are Holm-adjusted as one family. Other cuts are exploratory (tables only).
slides.source: Synthetic randomised monadic concept test (SBT-002); concepts and figures are fictitious.
